Another type of DLL, referred to as a recirculating DLL in the remainder of the paper, is implemented using a ring VCO with the phase realignment performed by periodically opening the ring to discard the noisy VCO edge and replacing it with a clean reference edge, as shown in Fig. 1(b) [2].

Alternatively, in a realigned PLL (RPLL), shown in Fig. 1(c), the phase realignment is performed by directly coupling a strongly buffered version of a clean reference source into one of the inverters in the VCO [3].
